import sys

def min_cost_to_correct(s, queries):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[[0, 0, 0, 0] for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    
    for length in range(2, n + 1, 2):
        for i in range(n - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            if s[i] == '(' and s[j] == ')':
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i + 1][j - 1][0]
            elif s[i] == '(' and s[j] == ']':
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i + 1][(j - 1) % n][0] + 1
            elif s[i] == '[' and s[j] == ')':
                dp[i][j][0] += dp[i + 1][j - 1][0] + 1
            elif s[i] == '[' and (s[j] == ']' or s[j] == ')'):
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i + 1][min(j - 1, n - 1)][0]
            
            if s[i] == '(' and s[j] == ')':
                pass
            elif s[i] == '(' and s[j] == ']':
                pass
            elif s[i] == '[' and s[j] == ')':
                
                dp[i][j][0] += 1
            elif s[i] == '[' and (s[j] in [']', ')']):
                dp[i][j][0] += 1
            
            dp[i][j][1] = min(dp[i][j][0], dp[i + 1][j - 1][1] + (s[i] != '(') + (s[j] != ')'))
            dp[i][j][2] = min(dp[i][j][0], dp[i + 1][(j - 1) % n][2] + (s[i] != '(') + (s[j] != ']'))
            dp[i][j][3] = min(dp[i][j][0], dp[i + 1 % n][j - 1][3] + (s[i] != '[') + (s[j] != ')'))
    
    results = []
    for l, r in queries:
        l -= 1
        r -= 1
        results.append(min(dp[l][r]))
    return results
